goal: Generate a product poster in a high-tech, engineering aesthetic style, featuring a vertical exploded view of the Apple Vision Pro 2, flanked by technical callouts, suitable as a long image for product stations or event launches.
subject: Apple Vision Pro 2 Spatial Computing Headset

style.rendering: High gloss aluminum-magnesium alloy and fabric precision 3D rendering, macro lens feel, key chip and lens edges with soft glows
style.background_color: Textured gradient from deep indigo to aurora purple
style.lighting: Top side 45° main light + dual soft light, with very fine cold white light outlining the edges of the lens glass, and very weak volumetric fog between layers

header.subtitle: Using optical stacks and on-device intelligence to make space the interface.

layout.centerpiece: Apple Vision Pro 2 Vertical Stacked Exploded View, 9 Layers from Bottom to Top: Outer Fabric Headband and Adjustment Knob Mechanism, Rear Pad Counterweight and Battery Strap Interface, M Series Tethered Computing and Cooling Duct Module, R1 or Subsequent Co-Processing and Sensor Fusion PCB, Multi-Lens Perspective and SLAM Camera Array, Eye Tracking Infrared Projection and Camera Ring, Pancake Dual-Eye Optical Module and Polarizing Film Set, OLED Micro Display Panel and Connectors, Front Curved Glass and Aluminum Alloy Main Frame and Speaker Cavity

left_side: M series tethered computing\nprovides graphics and multimodal inference under head-worn power constraints.
协处理 + 传感器融合\n降低透视与手眼追踪的端到端时延。
Pancake optical design\nbalances thickness and FOV to reduce neck strain.
right_side: 铝合金主框架 + 玻璃弧面\n结构刚度与佩戴舒适度的承力中枢。
多目透视与深度感知\n为数字内容与真实世界对齐。
眼动与面部追踪 IR\n注视点渲染与空间 UI 的输入基础。
织物头带 + 后枕配重\n长时佩戴的力学平衡。
近耳开放式扬声器\n空间音频与隐私感知的声场设计。

left_text_block.headline: See every layer, understand every detail.
left_text_block.body: From micro displays to perspective cameras, from computing power to fabric mechanics, each layer serves 'natural interaction in space'.

must_keep: Clear Sense of Component Hierarchy with Appropriate Distances Between Layers
callout leader line points to the correct component
The top and bottom brand areas do not obscure the main explosion structure
Overall, it has the completeness of a flagship release event long graphic.
avoid: Light machines and PCBA are too densely undistinguishable
Contradiction in the direction of highlights between mirror and glass
